name: Are there additional costs associated with relisting an expired property?

mainEntity.name: Are there additional costs associated with relisting an expired property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Relisting an expired property can involve some additional costs, though these are often minimal compared to the potential benefit of a sale. You may incur costs for new professional photography if your previous photos are outdated or need refreshing to reflect property updates. If you decide to make repairs, paint, or stage the home, these are also expenses to consider. Real estate commissions are typically paid upon the sale of the home, as per the new listing agreement. Kelby Contreras can help you budget for necessary improvements and clarify any commission structures for a relisted property, ensuring transparency in your financial planning.
